verdict.rationale: Apify's platform is built around Actors that can be run concurrently via API/client (tasks, run(), webhooks) with proxy/session rotation (datacenter+residential IP rotation, SessionPool) to avoid blocking at scale, plus scheduling and monitoring for reliability, and community praise for its scraping-at-scale reputation. missing for 10: explicit documented concurrency limits/autoscaling guarantees and a hands-on benchmark showing large-scale concurrent runs.
